payload.title: India's Performance at the 2023 Asian Games: Medal Tally

sections.heading: Findings
sections.body: India won a record 107 medals at the 19th Asian Games in Hangzhou, China, including 28 gold, 38 silver, and 41 bronze [E1][E2][E4][E5]. India achieved its best ever medal haul at the Asian Games with 106 medals including 28 gold, 38 silver, and 40 bronze medals and finished fourth in the overall medal table [E3].

sections.heading: Details
sections.body: India signed off with a record 107 medals at the 19th Asian Games in Hangzhou, China, including 28 gold, 38 silver, and 41 bronze [E1][E2][E4][E5]. The Games were held in Hangzhou, China [E1][E4].
